name: Drägerwerk AG & Co. KGaA
summary: Drägerwerk AG & Co. KGaA operates as a medical and safety technology company worldwide. It develops, produces, and markets system solutions, devices, and services for the medical division, including emergency medicine, perioperative care, intensive care, and perinatal medicine. The company also develops, produces, and markets products, system solutions, and services for personal protection, gas measurement technology, and comprehensive risk management to customers in industry and mining sectors, as well as public sectors, such as fire departments, police, and disaster protection. In addition, it offers patient monitoring systems; anaesthesia machines; medical ventilators and lung monitoring;…
